{{recipesummary|category=Casserole recipes|time=40 minutes|difficulty=2|}}
{{recipe}}

This potato casserole recipe is a long-time favorite in Utah. It is super fattening but very good. You can reduce the fat by using low fat cheese and fat free sour cream, and omit the butter. You can also use low-fat cream of chicken soup.

==Ingredients==
* 32 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] frozen hash browns
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* 1 can cream of chicken soup
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]
* ¼ cup melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] (you can omit this to save calories and reduce the fat content)
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]] (optional)
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 1 cup corn flakes cereal [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|tossed]] with 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] melted butter for topping

==Procedure==
#Combine all ingredients except cornflakes in a large bowl.
#Transfer the mixture to an 11x13-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] glass [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]].  
#Sprinkle the corn flake mixture on top.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 350°F for 40 minutes. It's done when it is all bubbly and a little bit browned on top.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*You can [[Cookbook:Mincing|mince]] up a white or yellow onion and use in place of green onion.
*For a milder onion flavor you could substitute chives for the green onions.
*Instead of hash browns, you can also use those frozen potatoes O'Brien that have chunks of peppers in them.
